title: Jeju City Tour Bus & Hop-On Hop-Off 2026: New 22-Stop Route, Timetable, Prices, Airport Stop 3
description: Jeju City Tour Bus (Jeju hop-on hop-off bus) guide, checked November 2026: the new 22-stop loop from 3 November past Jeju Airport, Dongmun Market and the coastal road, the KRW 12,000 day pass, 08:30–16:30 hourly timetable and where to board.
lead: The Jeju City Tour Bus is Jeju's hop-on hop-off bus. It loops around Jeju City past the ferry terminals, Dongmun Market, Yongduam Rock, Jeju International Airport, the rainbow coastal road at Dodubong, Iho Tewoo Beach, the five-day market, Dream Tower and the bus terminal. A day pass lets you hop on and off at 22 stops, and you simply pay when you board. The route and timetable changed on 3 November 2026.
summary: Loop · 22 stops · about 2 hours per loop (new route from 3 Nov 2026)

routes.name: Loop route (from 3 November 2026)
routes.tip: This is the route from 3 November 2026. The bus calls at the airport on the hour from 09:00 to 17:00. The extra 17:30 and 18:30 departures run only as far as the airport (arriving 18:00 and 19:00); in January and February the 16:30 loop ends at the airport at 17:00 and the 18:30 run does not operate.

priceNote: Prices from the official Jeju City Tour site on 6 November 2026.
howToBook: No booking needed: pay when you board at any stop (credit card or transport card).
Choose the day pass (KRW 12,000) for several stops or the single ride (KRW 5,000) for one trip.
Service may stop in typhoons or heavy rain or snow; call 064-741-8785 to check.
howToRide: At Jeju Airport, board at bus stop 3 on the 1st floor; you can also board at any of the 22 stops.
Pay as you board and keep your ticket; show the day pass when you reboard.
Get off anywhere and catch the next bus an hour later. The last full loop leaves the first stop at 16:30.
Pets can ride only in a bag or carrier.

faq.q: Is there a hop-on hop-off bus in Jeju?
faq.a: Yes. The Jeju City Tour Bus is Jeju's hop-on hop-off bus: one KRW 12,000 day pass covers unlimited rides at 22 stops around Jeju City, including Jeju Airport, Dongmun Market and the coastal road.

faq.q: Do I need to book the Jeju City Tour Bus?
faq.a: No. Pay when you board at any stop, by credit card or transport card.

faq.q: Can I board at Jeju Airport?
faq.a: Yes, at bus stop 3 on the airport's 1st floor. The bus calls on the hour from 09:00 to 17:00.

faq.q: What is the Jeju City Tour Bus timetable?
faq.a: Nine loops a day, hourly from 08:30 to 16:30 from Jeju Port International Passenger Terminal. A loop takes about 2 hours, and the bus reaches the airport about 30 minutes after leaving the port.

The loop grew to 22 stops: Sheraton Jeju Hotel and Oraemul Square were added, Halla Arboretum was dropped, the Nohyeong stop moved to Wonnohyeong by Dream Tower, and the first bus moved from 09:00 to 08:30.

faq.q: Does it cover the whole of Jeju Island?
faq.a: No. It loops around Jeju City in the north only. For Seongsan Ilchulbong, Hallasan or Seogwipo you need a day tour, a rental car or regular buses.
No, it is closed every Monday.

topics.h3: Jeju hop-on hop-off bus route map
topics.a: The new route from 3 November 2026 is a 22-stop loop from Jeju Port: Dongmun Market, Gwandeokjeong, Yongduam Rock, Jeju Airport, the Dodubong rainbow coastal road, Iho Tewoo Beach, the five-day market, Dream Tower and the intercity bus terminal. The map on this page numbers every stop in order.
topics.label: See the route and map

topics.a: Nine loops a day leave Jeju Port International Passenger Terminal hourly from 08:30 to 16:30, and each loop takes about 2 hours. The bus calls at the airport on the hour from 09:00 to 17:00. It does not run on Mondays.
topics.label: See the route and map

topics.a: A day pass is KRW 12,000 for adults, KRW 8,000 for children and youth and free for preschoolers; a single ride is KRW 5,000. You pay by credit card or transport card when you board, with no booking.
topics.label: See prices

topics.h3: Jeju City Tour Bus from Jeju Airport
topics.a: Board at bus stop 3 on the airport's 1st floor; the bus calls on the hour from 09:00 to 17:00. From the airport it runs west along the coast to Dodubong and Iho Tewoo Beach before turning back through the new town.
topics.label: See where to board

topics.h3: Jeju City Tour Bus itinerary for one day
topics.a: With an hourly bus, three or four stops fill the day. A simple plan from the airport: Dodubong and the rainbow coastal road, Iho Tewoo Beach, then round to Dongmun Market and Yongduam Rock, ending back at the airport.
